scope: Read-only source trace; no application startup, business data, runtime configuration, MQTT or device access.

findings.verified: obtain derives employee identity from SysUtil.currentUser().getEmpId(); platform ownership associates uavId with employeeId.
findings.not_proven: This record does not identify a vendor control_source or DRC MQTT session.

findings.verified: MqttBroker.client_id is a new UUID; uavRouteControl builds a new broker DTO from DJDockMqttProperties.
findings.not_proven: No retained employee/resource/control-session association was found on this send path; expire_time is credential expiry, not a session lease.

findings.verified: flight_authority_grab, drc_mode_enter and drc_mode_exit return void and publish ServicesReply envelopes. Enter starts local heartbeat after publishing; exit cancels it after publishing.
findings.not_proven: No correlated device reply is awaited by these methods; publishing or local heartbeat does not establish device authority.

findings.verified: publishWithPlatform delegates to the global platformMessageManager. PlatformMessageEngine constructs it from MqManagerEntity records and a managerId plus date-number client ID.
findings.not_proven: The runtime broker values were not read. Independent configuration sources do not prove that runtime brokers differ or coincide.

findings.verified: MQTT messages are converted then queued; consumer submits processing to an executor. MessageUtils.toMessageData drops retained/duplicate flags and manager/client/connection generation information.
findings.not_proven: Queued messages cannot be bound to their originating connection generation from the current MessageData contract. A processing-time lookup must not assign a newer generation to an older queued message.

findings.verified: Connection loss schedules reconnect; connectComplete resubscribes asynchronously; connect creates a new date-number client ID. The platform manager adapter explicitly sets cleanSession=true.
findings.not_proven: No control-session invalidation or old queued-message epoch barrier was found on this path.

findings.verified: timeStamp is assigned DateUtils.getDateTimeNumber(), formatted yyyyMMddHHmmss.
findings.not_proven: This value is not Unix epoch milliseconds and must not be subtracted from currentTimeMillis as a TTL measurement.

negative_search_scope.reported_by_peer: Both local source trees; operator/DRC/control_source, dynamic subscription and alternate DJApp paths.
negative_search_scope.root_reviewed: Key send, identity, broker-construction, ingress, queue-dispatch, timestamp and reconnect source slices plus 12 candidate source hashes.
negative_search_scope.result: No complete authenticated employee -> DRC session -> reported control_source binding found in the inspected paths.
negative_search_scope.limit: A bounded source audit cannot prove absence in runtime configuration, external services, firmware, unavailable history or uninspected device traffic.

reusable_paths.purpose: Persist-before-publish command association; currently six-direction fly_to scope

next_complete_slice: Capture manager, client, connection generation, receive epoch time and retained/duplicate metadata at MQTT receipt before queueing.
At actual control-service send boundaries bind authenticated employee, project/resource, session generation, request IDs, DRC client ID and broker/manager identity; account for old entry points.
Associate strict service replies, reported control source, link and heartbeat facts; invalidate on failure, timeout, disconnect, changed actor/resource or other control source.
Keep authority unknown until a protocol contract or independent device sample establishes how the reported control_source identifies the local control session.
Exercise send-before-reply races, late replies across reconnect, repeated/out-of-order/expired messages, concurrent sessions, ownership changes and restart recovery offline.
